recognize_zh: 血液抹片中中型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少量藍色且無顆粒，許多核的一側有一塊淡染的凹陷區（箭頭），呈杯口狀核（cup-like nuclei）；雖常見於 NPM1 突變 AML，此例在 B-ALL 中出現。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant to moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to slightly coarse chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Prominent pale nuclear invagination/pocket occupying part of the nucleus, giving a cup-like (fish-mouth) appearance (arrows in A-C)
Blasts appear singly and in small aggregates (B, C), without Auer rods or granules
Background red cells largely unremarkable; platelets scant
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. A subset of blasts shows a distinct pale nuclear invagination spanning a portion of the nucleus, producing cup-like nuclear morphology. No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules or maturing myeloid forms are seen in these fields. In the setting of a B-lineage immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with cup-like nuclei; because this morphology is classically associated with NPM1/FLT3-ITD-mutated AML, lineage must be established by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Blasts are typically larger with more cytoplasm, may show granules or Auer rods, and are MPO positive, CD34/HLA-DR often negative, rather than CD19/CD10 positive.
Shows bilobed or folded 'butterfly' nuclei with fine granules, strong MPO, and CD34/HLA-DR negativity with PML::RARA.
Can show convoluted nuclei but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7 rather than B-lineage markers.
Promonocytes have folded delicate nuclei with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules and nonspecific esterase positivity.
